title: Graph points are the inverse of the canonical equivalence ℝ^{n+ℓ} ≅ ℝⁿ × ℝ^ℓ
statement: For all n, ℓ ∈ ℕ, x ∈ ℝⁿ and y ∈ ℝ^ℓ, the graph point graphPoint x y = toLp 2 (Fin.append (ofLp x) (ofLp y)) (the vector of ℝ^{n+ℓ} whose first n coordinates are x and whose last ℓ coordinates are y) equals E.symm (x, y), where E := EuclideanSpace.finAddEquivProd : ℝ^{n+ℓ} ≃L[ℝ] ℝⁿ × ℝ^ℓ is Mathlib's canonical continuous linear equivalence sending z to the pair (first n coordinates of z, last ℓ coordinates of z).
lean_statement: ∀ {n ℓ : ℕ} (x : Rn n) (y : Rn ℓ), graphPoint x y = (EuclideanSpace.finAddEquivProd : Amb n ℓ ≃L[ℝ] Rn n × Rn ℓ).symm (x, y)
